sourceContract: Claude Code hook JSON protocol (PostToolUse fired inside a subagent: agent_id/agent_type present), per code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks
author: otel-hook worktree-target owner (agent)
sanitization: Shape only. Every value is invented: ids are fabricated, file contents and commands are placeholders, and paths live under a fictional /workspace tree (contract-repo = the main checkout, contract-repo-slot-7 = a linked worktree) that tests rebase onto a temporary directory.
